messages.text: Handle this: create hello.txt containing exactly Hello Rich with no trailing newline. Do not create other files.

I have this. The deliverable is a file named hello.txt in this company's working area whose entire contents are the two words Hello Rich, exactly that capitalization and spacing, with no trailing newline and no other characters before or after; nothing else may be created, so no scratch files, no backups and no accompanying notes, and no existing file may be overwritten or removed to make room. It is with my team now and I will tell you when it is actually done and checked, not before.

One other thing, separate from that: I don't have anything on file about your business yet. When you have twenty minutes or so, I can ask you about what the company does, who it's for, and how you want me to work — and write the answers down so I use them from then on. No rush, and it can wait until this is off your desk.

hello.txt is done and checked. It sits in this company's working area and contains exactly Hello Rich — right capitalization, one space, nothing before or after it and no trailing line break. Nothing else was created: that file is the only thing in the folder, no scratch copies, no backups, no notes, and nothing existing was touched. No limitations to flag.

That clears your desk, so the twenty minutes on your business is open whenever you want it.The report above stands: hello.txt is complete and verified, contents exactly Hello Rich with no trailing newline and no other files created.
